bluetooth_confirm.title: Set up MiniBig Device
bluetooth_confirm.description: Do you want to set up {name} ({address})?

user.title: Select MiniBig Device
user.description: Choose a discovered MiniBig BLE device to set up.

abort.not_minibig_device: The discovered device is not a recognized MiniBig device
abort.hubmini_not_supported: HubMini is an external gateway and is not directly supported in Home Assistant. Home Assistant communicates with MiniBig devices directly via BLE.
abort.no_devices_found: No unconfigured MiniBig devices found on Bluetooth.

init.title: MiniBig Options
init.description: Configure BLE connection, polling interval, and custom DP mapping.

data_description.keep_connected: Maintains a permanent BLE connection. WARNING: The official smartphone app cannot connect while enabled, and device battery drain will increase.
data_description.dp_overrides: Advanced. Maps named settings to DP IDs discovered on your hardware, e.g. measure: 7. Leave empty unless you have captured them.
data_description.cover_device_class: Select the cover type that matches your device. Affects the icon and name shown in the Home Assistant UI.

send_raw.name: Send Raw Command
send_raw.description: Sends a raw opcode and optional hex payload directly to the MiniBig device over BLE GATT.

method.name: Method (Opcode)
method.description: Numeric opcode (e.g. 42 for PUB_DPS, 43 for READ_DPS, 17 for RESTART).

publish_dps.name: Publish DPS
publish_dps.description: Sets one or more DP values on the MiniBig device.

dps.name: DP List
dps.description: List of DP objects containing dp_id and value.
